Sean / team — drafting redline snippets below and attaching a consolidated PDF (ORBDoc_v3_redline_MSA.pdf). Please note the following design choices so Sales knows the tradeoffs: 

1) Audit logs / retention: Add Exhibit G (Audit & Logs). Provision: Redwood will retain system audit logs for 7 years for accounts on Reserved or Private plans; Hosted customers receive 1 year unless a contractual exhibit is executed. We will include a scoped definition of "audit logs" and a customer request process for on-demand exports (48-72 hours for ad-hoc exports, 30 days for full export for Private deployments).

2) Liability cap: Propose tiered liability: (a) For term <= 12 months, cap = 3x monthly recurring charges; (b) For term >12 months and <=24 months, cap = 6x MRC; (c) For multi-year (>=36 months or committed spend > $5M) negotiate custom cap. This mirrors precedent and keeps risk bounded.

3) SOC2 evidence: Insert clause that Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II evidence on request and a 30-day evidence turnaround for Private deployments; for Hosted the default is redacted artefacts within 45 days.

I'm also flagging a billing nuance — Order Form now includes a one-time migration fee for the capacity uplift; Ops (Tessa) please confirm whether that fee should be invoiced upfront or amortized.

Attaching: ORBDoc_v3_redline_MSA.pdf, OrderForm-2026-uptick.xlsx

-Laura
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
